The '''Palisade starport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] in the city of [[Palisade]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]]. The starport contained [[Docking Pad P13]] and was secured by the [[Palisade Starport Control]].<ref name="FP">{{GamerCite|1|Fair Prey}}</ref>
